text: sail reads the format from the first 64 bytes, since every format's magic is on the first line. Stdin is refused at a terminal so a bare sail count does not hang, and is otherwise read whole, only because a pipe cannot be reopened. Every other input is identified with a short read and handed on unopened, so nothing is buffered twice. FormatArg mirrors libsail's Format as a separate clap-facing type so libsail need not depend on clap; the From impl is the whole mapping.
